subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• The New York Times newspaper was first published in 1851.
• The newspaper has long been known for its investigative journalism and political coverage.
• In 2020, media scholar Hanna Lysenko published the book Hidden Voices and the "New York Times."
• Its subject is immigrant journalists whose columns appeared in the newspaper during the 1960s.
• One of the journalists discussed is Hanane Idrissi.
prompt: The student wants to introduce Hanna Lysenko's book to an audience already familiar with the New York Times. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: A newspaper called the New York Times, referenced in Hanna Lysenko's book title, was first published in 1851.
choices.B: Hidden Voices and the "New York Times" features contributors to the New York Times, first published in 1851 as a newspaper known for investigative journalism and political coverage.
choices.C: A journalist discussed by Hanna Lysenko is Hanane Idrissi, whose columns appeared in the New York Times during the 1960s.
choices.D: Hanna Lysenko's Hidden Voices and the "New York Times" discusses immigrant journalists whose columns appeared in the newspaper during the 1960s.

explanation: Choice D is the best answer. The sentence effectively introduces Hanna Lysenko's book to an audience already familiar with the New York Times, noting the title of Lysenko's book and describing its content without providing background information about the New York Times.
